what: Fail-safe labels of the scenario library's cells, derived by tools/failsafe_rubric.py (docs/RUBRIC-failsafe.md) on the ideal and the rail vehicle

readings.a: ideal vehicle, E5 on the flight without a fail-safe (section 3)
readings.a2: ideal vehicle, E5 on the prescribed flight (section 7; the templates' labels)
readings.r: rail vehicle, E5 on the flight without a fail-safe (sections 3 and 8)
readings.r2: rail vehicle, E5 on the prescribed flight (sections 7 and 8)

adopted: 2026-11-10, the user's decision of 9-10 November ("follow the best practice that meets the KPI criteria"), after the rig had shown the autopilot's lag (rh01, 2026-11-07): not a pre-registered reading; (a) and (r) are printed beside it
length: scenario: read at the scenario's own length. rail: undecided there (no clause holds and an E5 spell was still running at its end) and read on the cell flown 35 s longer, as a rail flies it (sweep_scenarios.rail_max_s; section 8)
undecided: expected null: undecided at the scenario's length and not resolved by the longer flight (or none was flown); not guessed

rail.model: delayed command, jerk- and acceleration-limited target, first-order airframe lag (sweep_scenarios.VehicleResponse)
rail.fitted_to: hil rehearsal rh01, 7 Nov 2026: 32 flights, 6570 samples
